recentItems.title: Ari Lennox "Horoscope" Live Performance | VISIONARIES by UPROXX Studios
recentItems.description:
Ari Lennox steps onto the VISIONARIES XR stage for a stunning live performance of her song "Horoscope" from her new album "Vacancy." The screen behind her includes a unique technology that's reactive to Ari's movements and vocals so the entire visual is being created in real time as she sings. Welcome to VISIONARIES.

recentItems.title: will.i.am and Becky G Talk Being Global Artists, DM Hacks, and Repping LA | VISIONARIES Interview
recentItems.description:
Global superstar Becky G sat down with will.i.am shortly after performing at SoFi Stadium in her hometown of Inglewood, California. The two talk about their musical relationship over time, growing within an industry that may always want you to grow, and the creation of her new album Baraja Bendita.
